cohort: The study included all low-risk, nulliparous women with singleton, vertex, term births who gave birth in Iceland from 1997 to 2015.
finding: The risk of obstetric interventions generally increased with advancing maternal age, although the risk of instrumental births was not increased for women over 40 years.
mod_finding: For women aged over 40 years, there were increased risks for prelabor and intrapartum cesarean birth, while the risk of instrumental birth was slightly increased for women aged 35-39 years but not for those 40+ years; young women (under 20) had a decreased risk of instrumental births.
